One wall description puts the flat area beneath the cliff at about 5,800 ft (matching bivy[3]); the main route database lists the Cutthroat Wall area at 6,120 ft (matching the waypoint) but as an area elevation, not explicitly the base. The bivy entry is also out of scope for patching.
